---
name: clinical-dialogue-mini
description: Conduct a bounded host-simulated clinical dialogue using focused questions, examinations, and images without claiming real patient care.
---

# Clinical dialogue

1. Ask focused questions that resolve a stated uncertainty in the current
   host-provided state.
2. Request an examination or image only through the named host tool and record
   returned findings as observations.
3. Keep a differential, limitations, and next-information request separate
   from observed facts.
4. Treat the interaction as simulation or authorized research, not a real
   patient encounter or a substitute for clinician review.
